propositions: A single mapped project's transport error (400/401/403/404/429/5xx/timeout) in base-query execution currently aborts the entire reconciler pass for all projects, when only that project should fail open and others should continue

The base-query loop lacks per-project error isolation that already exists in the enrichment loop below it (_enrich_project), causing the 2026-08-15 outage where a nonexistent project key LEG propagated a transport failure across ~12h of all scheduled passes
The current flat loop design risks partial snapshot merges where incomplete issues from a failed project are written to the shared snapshot, causing the differ to misread them as deletions

Per-project transport errors must emit observable alerts (fetcher-project-fetch-failed) and continue to other projects, while syntactically invalid keys and BackendPaginationStallError must still fail closed (preserving 626d intent)

The extracted _fetch_project helper must drain both base queries (active + done-recent) into a LOCAL dict and merge to shared snapshot atomically—all-or-nothing per project—to guarantee no partial keys leak
